billing.faq.trial.question: How does the free trial work?
billing.faq.trial.answer: The free trial lasts 72 hours from account creation and unlocks Creation Chat, Prompt, Blueprint, projects, builds, preview, and AI under Trial limits. After it expires, you can still view your projects, but creation, builds, preview, AI, patches, and publishing are blocked until you subscribe to a plan.
billing.faq.student.question: How does the Student Plan work?
billing.faq.student.answer: The Student Plan costs R$30.00/month and grants exactly the same features and limits as the Basic Plan. It requires current proof of enrollment and revalidation every 12 months.
billing.faq.cancel.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
billing.faq.cancel.answer: Yes. When you cancel, your projects, history, Prompt, Blueprint, and builds are preserved.
